nodes.title: Prompt completo
widgets_values: Image 1 shows a fashion model wearing the product outfit. Image 2 is a pose skeleton (a colored stick figure on a black background): use it only as the target body pose. Create a new full-body fashion photograph of the same model from image 1, wearing exactly the same outfit from image 1, standing in exactly the pose shown by the skeleton in image 2: same position of head, shoulders, arms, hands, legs and feet, whole body visible from head to feet. The clothing must be copied only from image 1: keep every garment and accessory identical to image 1, with the same colors, fabric, texture, print, stripes, logos, trims, length and fit. Do not invent or replace any clothing. Keep the same face, hair, background, lighting and camera as image 1. Photorealistic photo. Do not draw any skeleton lines or colored dots.

nodes.title: Como usar
widgets_values:
## W2 — Pose em imagem (FLUX.2 klein 9B base)
Produto (image 1) + esqueleto de 1 keyframe do W1 (image 2) → modelo com a peça naquela pose. 4 ramos = 4 keyframes.

**Trocar a peça:** no nó *Image 1 - Produto* suba a foto de frente, corpo inteiro, e reescreva *Descricao da peca* (em inglês).

**Trocar o movimento:** nos nós *Image 2 - Pose 1..4* use as `keyframes/pose_*.png` do W1. Mude *Nome do teste* para não sobrescrever.

**Teste barato:** 480×848, 20 passos, CFG 3.5, seed fixa. Rodar só um ramo: selecione os *Salva pose* que não quer e Ctrl+M.

Saída: `output/motion/W2/<nome>/pose-1..4`.

Produto atual é **provisório**: frame 1 do próprio vídeo look-02.
